description: Defines ASN.1 structures and classes for 3GPP NR RRC BCCH-BCH messages, including sequence and choice types, with serialization methods.

classes.name: pdcch_cfg_sib1_s
classes.description: Represents PDCCH-ConfigSIB1 ASN.1 sequence with packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: mib_s
classes.description: Represents MIB ASN.1 sequence with nested options and serialization methods.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents BCCH-BCH message type choice with methods to set and get message type, and serialization.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents BCCH-BCH message ASN.1 sequence containing message type, with serialization methods.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type in bcch_bch_msg_type_c.

methods.name: set_mib
methods.description: Sets the message type to MIB in bcch_bch_msg_type_c.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension in bcch_bch_msg_type_c.
